constraints.name: ck_batch_analysis_counts
constraints.expression: row_count >= 0 AND accepted_count >= 0 AND rejected_count >= 0 AND row_count = accepted_count + rejected_count

constraints.name: ck_batch_analysis_row_review
constraints.expression: (row_state = 'accepted' AND review_id IS NOT NULL) OR (row_state = 'rejected' AND review_id IS NULL)

constraints.name: ck_snapshot_context_scope
constraints.expression: NOT batch_context_permitted OR (context_scope_key IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(context_scope_key)) > 0)

constraints.name: ck_graph_job_scope
constraints.expression: (operation IN ('review_upsert','review_delete') AND review_id IS NOT NULL AND graph_snapshot_id IS NULL) OR (operation = 'snapshot_rebuild' AND review_id IS NULL AND graph_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: ck_graph_job_idempotency_owner
constraints.expression: idempotency_key IS NULL OR requested_by_user_id IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: ck_inference_counts
constraints.expression: requested_count > 0 AND completed_count >= 0 AND completed_count <= requested_count

constraints.name: ck_inference_idempotency_owner
constraints.expression: idempotency_key IS NULL OR requested_by_user_id IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: ck_model_threshold
constraints.expression: recommended_threshold IS NULL OR recommended_threshold BETWEEN 0 AND 1

constraints.name: ck_model_checkpoint_sha256
constraints.expression: checkpoint_sha256 IS NULL OR (length(checkpoint_sha256) = 64 AND lower(checkpoint_sha256) = checkpoint_sha256)

constraints.name: ck_model_verified_requirements
constraints.expression: lifecycle_status <> 'verified' OR (checkpoint_uri IS NOT NULL AND checkpoint_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND recommended_threshold IS NOT NULL AND threshold_source IS NOT NULL AND verification_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: ck_feedback_label
constraints.expression: ground_truth_label IS NULL OR ground_truth_label IN (0,1)

constraints.name: ck_feedback_idempotency_owner
constraints.expression: idempotency_key IS NULL OR submitted_by_user_id IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: ck_reviews_rating
constraints.expression: rating IS NULL OR rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5

constraints.name: ck_reviews_ground_truth
constraints.expression: ground_truth_label IS NULL OR ground_truth_label IN (0, 1)
